roundedToEuro.description: Whether the financial statements are presented in euro rounded to the euro (IT Codice civile art. 2423).
roundedToEuro.title: Rounded To Euro

inventoryMeasurementBasis.description: Inventory measurement basis; must state the lower of cost and net realisable value (IT art. 2426 n.9 / OIC 13 / ES PGC norma 10ª), e.g. 'lower-of-cost-and-nrv'.
inventoryMeasurementBasis.title: Inventory Measurement Basis

inventoryCostFormula.description: Cost-flow assumption for fungible inventories (IT art. 2426 n.10 / OIC 13 / ES norma 10ª): weighted-average cost, FIFO or LIFO.
inventoryCostFormula.title: Inventory Cost Formula

inventoryCostFormulaDisclosed.description: Whether the difference between the inventory cost formula and current cost at year-end is disclosed in the notes (IT art. 2426 n.10).
inventoryCostFormulaDisclosed.title: Inventory Cost Formula Disclosed

oic34Applied.description: Whether OIC 34 (Ricavi) is applied; required for IT statements whose period begins on or after 2024-01-01 (it-oic34-effective-2024).
oic34Applied.title: Oic34Applied

icac2021RevenueApplied.description: Whether the ICAC resolution of 10 Feb 2021 (norma 14ª five-step revenue model) is applied; required for ES statements whose period begins on or after 2021-01-01 (es-pgc-norma14-icac-2021).
icac2021RevenueApplied.title: Icac2021Revenue Applied

statementModel.description: The annual-accounts model the statement is drawn up on (e.g. 'full', 'normal', 'abbreviated', 'abreviado', 'pymes', 'micro'); must be consistent with the size class (ES PGC parte 3ª, BE NBB/BNB models).
statementModel.title: Statement Model

cashFlowStatementPresent.description: Whether a cash-flow statement is included; required for the normal/full model and omitted on the abbreviated model (ES PGC parte 3ª).
cashFlowStatementPresent.title: Cash Flow Statement Present

equityChangesStatementPresent.description: Whether a statement of changes in equity is included; required for the normal/full model (ES PGC parte 3ª).
equityChangesStatementPresent.title: Equity Changes Statement Present

retentionYears.description: Declared statutory record-retention period in years; must meet the jurisdiction minimum (IT 10y, ES 6y, BE 7y, PT/FR/DE/LU 10y, NL/AT 7y, NO 5y).
retentionYears.title: Retention Years

EInvoiceMandate.title: E-Invoicing Mandate Profile
EInvoiceMandate.description: Per-administration profile recording compliance with a national structured e-invoicing / e-reporting mandate (Italy SdI, Belgium Peppol, France 2026, Germany 2025, Poland KSeF, Romania e-Factura, Hungary RTIR, Greece myDATA, Lithuania i.SAF, Spain VERI*FACTU / TicketBAI / SII, Portugal e-Fatura). Evaluated jurisdiction-gated by the rule engine.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this mandate profile for tenant isolation.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

enabled.description: Whether structured e-invoicing / e-reporting is enabled for this administration.
enabled.title: Enabled

structuredFormat.description: The structured invoice format(s) supported (e.g. FatturaPA, Factur-X, XRechnung, Peppol-BIS, FA(2), myDATA).
structuredFormat.title: Structured Format

transmissionChannel.description: The clearing/transmission network(s) used (e.g. SdI, Peppol, KSeF, e-Factura, e-Fatura, AEAT, OnlineSzamla, AADE, VMI, PPF).
transmissionChannel.title: Transmission Channel

chainedRecords.description: Whether invoice records are tamper-evident and chained (ES VERI*FACTU / TicketBAI).
chainedRecords.title: Chained Records

realTime.description: Whether invoice data is reported in near real time (ES SII, HU RTIR).
realTime.title: Real Time

qrCode.description: Whether invoices carry a QR code (PT e-Fatura).
qrCode.title: Qr Code

atcud.description: Whether invoices carry the ATCUD unique document code (PT e-Fatura).
atcud.title: Atcud

liveFrom.description: Date from which the profile is operational; must be on or before the statutory go-live (BE 2026-01-01, FR 2026-09-01, DE 2025-01-01).
liveFrom.title: Live From

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a E-Invoicing Mandate Profile is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).

SaftExportProfile.title: SAF-T Export Profile
SaftExportProfile.description: Per-administration profile recording the system's ability to produce a national standard audit file (SAF-T / FEC / FAIA / JPK / D406 / i.SAF-T) on demand or periodically (Portugal, Romania D406, Lithuania, Norway, Austria, Luxembourg, France, Poland, Denmark, Bulgaria). Evaluated jurisdiction-gated by the rule engine.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this export profile for tenant isolation.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

capable.description: Whether the bookkeeping system can produce the standard audit file.
capable.title: Capable

standard.description: The standard audit-file format(s) supported (e.g. SAF-T (OECD), FEC, FAIA, JPK, D406, i.SAF-T, financial, accounting).
standard.example: SAF-T (OECD) — PT / RO D406 / FAIA / FEC / JPK
standard.title: Standard

onDemand.description: Whether the file can be produced on demand during a tax audit (AT, FR, DK).
onDemand.title: On Demand

coveredAreas.description: Data areas the export covers (RO D406 requires general ledger, AR/AP, fixed assets and inventory).
coveredAreas.title: Covered Areas

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a SAF-T Export Profile is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).
